description:
Who We Are 
 Charles River Development (CRD) is the FinTech division of State Street.  Together with State Street’s Middle and Back-office services, Charles River’s cloud-based Front Office technology forms the foundation of the State Street Alpha® Platform, the first front-to-back solution in the industry.  
  
 Our vision is to be the world’s leading investment platform, shaping the future of the industry and driving new levels of technology-led innovation, resiliency, efficiency and growth for investors and the people they serve.  
  
 CRD Engineering organization is innovating and transforming the platform by moving away from monolithic software to utilising next generation cloud-based technology that leverages Microsoft Azure, Kafka, Snowflake, etc. 
  
 Industry momentum has seen CRD grow over 135% in headcount over the last 5 years, and we continue to grow. As a digital innovation leader, we invest into our solutions, processes, systems, and talent. 
  
 Summary 
 We are seeking a Data Integration Engineer to design, build, and evolve the data integration capabilities powering the Next-Gen Data Platform within the State Street Alpha ecosystem. In this role, you will develop cloud‑native, scalable, and resilient data integration services using microservices and serverless architectures, including Azure Functions. 
 This is a hands‑on engineering role for an experienced developer (4–8 years) who enjoys solving complex data and distributed systems problems. The role combines  greenfield framework development  with ownership of  mission‑critical enterprise integrations , including the opportunity to ramp up on and support existing internal Java‑based import/export frameworks (built on Java and Pentaho Kettle) and enterprise integration frameworks built using Talend–based solutions that remain essential to the platform. 
  
 Responsibilities 
 Analyze, design, develop, test, and maintain large‑scale, cloud‑native data integration services using microservices and serverless patterns (e.g., Azure Functions). 
 Contribute to the design and implementation of core data integration platforms and services, with a focus on scalability, resiliency, operability, and performance. 
 Build and enhance APIs and services supporting batch, near‑real‑time, and event‑driven data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
 Collaborate closely with architects, business analysts, product managers, and partner engineering teams across CRIMS and the broader Alpha Platform to deliver simple, sustainable solutions to complex problems. 
 Develop, test, debug, and deploy software primarily using  Java ,  SQL , and related cloud‑native technologies. 
 Perform code reviews and provide informed guidance on design and implementation decisions. 
 Write unit, integration, and automation tests to ensure a high‑quality, reliable platform. 
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues in distributed, cloud‑based production systems, including root‑cause analysis for mission‑critical client implementations. 
 Support and enhance existing internal Java‑based import/export frameworks (built on Java and Pentaho Kettle) and enterprise integration frameworks built using Talend integrations as part of overall data platform ownership. 
 Participate actively in the agile development process, including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives. 
 Mentor and guide junior engineers, demonstrating increasing independence in design and development. 
 Produce and maintain technical documentation, design artifacts, and operational runbooks. 
  
 Qualifications 
 Education 
 B.S. degree (or foreign education equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field required. 
 M.S. degree preferred. 
 
 Experience & Technical Skills 
 4–8   years  of professional software engineering experience. 
 Experience designing and developing  cloud‑native   services , preferably on  Microsoft Azure . 
 Hands‑on experience with  microservices architectures ,  serverless technologies , and event‑driven systems. 
 Strong proficiency in  Java . Experience with Spring‑based frameworks is required
 Solid experience with  SQL  and data‑intensive applications. 
 Understanding modern data integration architectures, data transformation, and data quality concepts. 
 Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and deployment concepts, including networking, security, identity, configuration, and secrets management. 
 Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git‑based source control, and automated testing frameworks. 
 Ability and willingness to ramp up quickly on internal Java‑based import/export frameworks (built on Java and Pentaho Kettle) and enterprise integration frameworks built using Talend for ongoing development and production support. 
 Demonstrated problem‑solving ability in multi‑tiered, high‑performance, mission‑critical systems. 
 
 Nice to Have 
 Hands‑on experience with  Azure   services  such as Azure Functions, Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, and monitoring/observability tools. 
 Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 Familiarity with modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake or similar technologies. 
 Experience working in financial services or with large‑scale enterprise data platforms. 
 Prior experience supporting client‑facing, production‑critical systems. 
  
 Soft Skills 
 Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Ability to work effectively with peers in a collaborative, globally distributed team environment. 
 Comfortable balancing new framework development with ownership and support of existing enterprise platforms. 
  
 Work Arrangement 
 Employees are expected to work from the office  4   days per week , in alignment with team and business needs. 
  
 Travel 
 May be required on a limited basis. 
 
 Salary Range: 
$90,000 - $157,500 Annual 
 The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. 
 
 Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans. 
 For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home . 

 About State Street 

 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

 Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers 

 Read our CEO Statement
